Bill.BriefDescription: Transferring the human immunodeficiency virus insurance program to the department of health.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the human immunodeficiency virus insuranceprogram; adding a new section to chapter 43.70 RCW; repealing RCW74.09.757; providing an effective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 74.09.757 (Acquired humanimmunodeficiency syndrome insurance program (HIV/AIDS)) and 1993 c 264s 1 & 1989 c 260 s 3 are each repealed.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) "Human immunodeficiency virus insurance program," as used inthis section, means the program that provides health insurance coveragefor individuals with human immunodeficiency virus, as defined in RCW70.24.017(7), who meet eligibility requirements established by thedepartment of health. (2) The department of health may pay for health insurance coverageon behalf of persons with human immunodeficiency virus, who meetdepartment eligibility requirements, and who are eligible for p. 1 HB 1275"continuation coverage" as provided by the federal consolidated omnibusbudget reconciliation act of 1985, group health insurance policies, orindividual policies.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2003.
